lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit ko laaiaa tit hee laagaa ||
lines.translation: As the Lord attaches someone, so is he attached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੮॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: so sevak naanak jis bhaagaa ||8||6||
lines.translation: He alone is the Lord's servant, O Nanak, who is so blessed. ||8||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਸਰਪ ਆਰਜਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran jaise sarap aarajaaree ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's life is like that of a snake.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tiu jeevahi saakat naam bisaaree ||1||
lines.translation: This is how the faithless cynic lives, forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek nimakh jo simaran mahi jeeaa ||
lines.translation: One who lives in meditative remembrance, even for an instant,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਲਾਖ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot dinas laakh sadaa thir theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: lives for hundreds of thousands and millions of days, and becomes stable forever. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran dhrig karam karaas ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's actions and works are cursed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਗ ਬਤਨ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaag batan bisataa mahi vaas ||2||
lines.translation: Like the crow's beak, he dwells in manure. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਭਏ ਕੂਕਰ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran bhae kookar kaam ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one acts like a dog.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਪੂਤ ਨਿਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saakat besuaa poot ninaam ||3||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic is nameless, like the prostitute's son. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੀਙ ਛਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran jaise seeng chhataaraa ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a horned ram.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਹਿ ਕੂਰੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: bolahi koor saakat mukh kaaraa ||4||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic barks out his lies, and his face is blackened. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਗਰਧਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran garadhabh kee niaaee ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a donkey.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਥਾਨ ਭਰਿਸਟ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: saakat thaan bharisat phiraahee ||5||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic wanders around in polluted places. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੂਕਰ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran kookar harakaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a mad dog.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਲੋਭੀ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: saakat lobhee ba(n)dh na paaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: The greedy, faithless cynic falls into entanglements. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਹੈ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin simaran hai aatam ghaatee ||
lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he murders his own soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨੀਚ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: saakat neech tis kul nahee jaatee ||7||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic is wretched, without family or social standing. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis bhaiaa kripaal tis satasa(n)g milaaiaa ||
lines.translation: When the Lord becomes merciful, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak gur jagat taraaiaa ||8||7||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world. ||8||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan mohi param gat paaee ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I have attained the supreme status.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai meree paij rakhaaee ||1||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has preserved my honor. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan dhiaaio mohi naau ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I meditate on the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad mohi miliaa thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained a place of rest. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan sun rasan vakhaanee ||
lines.translation: I listen to the Guru's Word, and chant it with my tongue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te a(n)mrit meree baanee ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, my speech is like nectar. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan mitiaa meraa aap ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my selfishness and conceit have been removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee daiaa te meraa vad parataap ||3||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's kindness, I have obtained glorious greatness. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan mitiaa meraa bharam ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my doubts have been removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan pekhio sabh braham ||4||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I see God everywhere. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan keeno raaj jog ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sa(n)g tariaa sabh log ||5||
lines.translation: In the Company of the Guru, all the people of the world are saved. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan mere kaaraj sidh ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my affairs are resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan paaiaa naau nidh ||6||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I have obtained the nine treasures. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jin keenee mere gur kee aasaa ||
lines.translation: Whoever places his hopes in my Guru,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee kateeai jam kee phaasaa ||7||
lines.translation: has the noose of death cut away. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan jaagiaa meraa karam ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my good karma has been awakened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੮॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur bhetiaa paarabraham ||8||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God. ||8||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kau simarau saas saas ||
lines.translation: I remember the Guru with each and every breath.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur mere praan satigur meree raas ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru is my breath of life, the True Guru is my wealth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa darasan dekh dekh jeevaa ||
lines.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I live.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan dhoi dhoi peevaa ||1||
lines.translation: I wash the Guru's Feet, and drink in this water. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee ren nit majan karau ||
lines.translation: I take my daily bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਰਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee haumai mal harau ||2||
lines.translation: The egotistical filth of countless incarnations is washed off. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਝੂਲਾਵਉ ਪਾਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kau jhoolaavau paakhaa ||
lines.translation: I wave the fan over the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਹਾਥੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa agan te haath de raakhaa ||3||
lines.translation: Giving me His Hand, He has saved me from the great fire. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਢੋਵਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kai grihi dhovau paanee ||
lines.translation: I carry water for the Guru's household;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਅਕਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jis gur te akal gat jaanee ||4||
lines.translation: from the Guru, I have learned the Way of the One Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੀਸਉ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kai grihi peesau neet ||
lines.translation: I grind the corn for the Guru's household.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਸਭ ਮੀਤ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jis parasaad vairee sabh meet ||5||
lines.translation: By His Grace, all my enemies have become friends. ||5||
